snippet.title: Lady Mabel Mysteries: Death on Board Game Trailer
snippet.description:
In the tradition of classic murder mysteries, Elephant Games proudly presents Lady Mabel Mysteries: Death on Board, the first entry in a brand-new series!

Mystery author Lady Mabel Porter sets off on a comfort cruise seeking inspiration for her latest detective story, only to find herself tangled up in a real-life mystery of rivalry, passion, and murder! With suspects stacking up and a mysterious figure watching her every move, it’s only a matter of time before Lady Mabel either solves the case or becomes the killer’s next victim! 

Can you help her solve the case, catch the criminal, and finish her story? There’s just one way to find out! Come aboard and set a course for mayhem in the first exciting entry in a brand new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game series!

Available for Game Club Members on October 23rd!

https://www.bigfishgames.com/

Wade into a wide collection of downloadable games for PC and Mac at Big Fish Games! Try before you dive with free trials on every title!
